customer.text: how long and what do I need to send

historyBefore.text: I want TikTok setup and how much is it does that include ads money

The TikTok account setup service covers creating and configuring your TikTok advertising account so you can run ads. However, the setup fee does not include the actual money spent on ads (ad spend). You will need to budget separately for the ads money you want to spend on your campaigns.

To give you an exact price for the setup service, could you please confirm how long you want to run your ads or if you want any additional management services? Or do you just want the setup done so you can run the ads yourself?

content.text:
For TikTok account setup, the typical duration depends on how quickly you want your ads to start running, but the setup itself usually takes a few days to complete.

To proceed, I’ll need some basic info from you such as your business name, contact details, and any existing TikTok account if you have one. If you want us to manage your ads afterward, any info on your ad budget and campaign goals will also be useful.

Would you like just the setup service, or do you want us to manage your ads as well? Also, do you have a preferred timeframe in mind for running your ads?
